findings.claim: Catalog enrollment mishandles normal publications that publish all columns because it decodes nullable `pg_publication_tables.attnames` as a non-null `Vec<String>`.
findings.evidence: The `load_relation` hunk selects `attnames, rowfilter FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication_tables` and immediately does `published.get::<_, Vec<String>>(0).into_iter().collect()`, while both the new fixture and deployment use publications without column lists (`CREATE PUBLICATION c008_publication FOR TABLE ...` in `crates/frf-gateway/tests/support/cdc/mod.rs` and `CREATE PUBLICATION frf_pub;` in `deploy/postgres/init.sql`), for which PostgreSQL reports `attnames` as NULL to mean all columns.
findings.suggested_fix: Read `attnames` as `Option<Vec<String>>`; treat `None` as all physical columns from `pg_attribute`, and only filter columns when it is `Some(list)`.

findings.claim: Task 5 is marked complete even though the evidence says the required archive review is still pending.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5 requires: `Resolve required review findings before archive`; `openspec/changes/pri-c008-cdc-commit-mapping/tasks.md` marks task 5 `[x]`, but `receipt.md` says `Status: **PASS; ARCHIVE REVIEW PENDING**` and later `A fresh resolution review is still required before archive`, and `.refiner/artifacts/pri-c008-cdc-commit-mapping/state.json` has `convergence_status`: `running`.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not mark task 5 complete or archive-ready until the required independent resolution review has passed and the evidence/state files reflect a completed convergence state.
